title: fix(objectql): an update carrying a stored reference back unchanged is not refused because it stopped resolving (#29062)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93jDJpyZ4T5x8DmbvSnfEjZ)_

Fixes #29062

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：写入时的引用校验只判这次写入"新增"的引用值；记录里本来就存着、这次原样带回的值（包括多用户字段里的单个成员）不再重判。
- 为什么改：删除用户后，单/多用户字段里仍留着该用户 id（删除联动不覆盖 user 类型）；之后编辑这条记录、表单把整条记录带回时，会被 reference_not_found 拒绝，而编辑者根本没碰这个字段。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽不收紧，以前能过的写入现在照样能过；新增的不存在 id 仍然拒绝，插入仍逐值校验。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts（被拒值与存量行比对的那段），packages/objectql/src/engine.ts（按 id 更新与批量更新两处调用），packages/objectql/src/engine-lookup-referential-integrity.test.ts（新 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-lookup-referential-integrity.test.ts，预期 21 条全绿，其中 #29062 的 7 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`assertReferencesResolve` (the write-time `reference_not_found` check) gains an optional `storedRows` reader: the rows the write lands on, as stored before it. After the probes run, a refused value (or a refused member of a multi-valued field) that **every** one of those rows already stores is dropped from the failures: it is not a reference this write adds. The stored rows are read only once a probe has refused, so a write whose references all resolve reads nothing new.

Every call site of `this.assertReferencesResolve(` and what it now does:

| Call site | Stored row to compare against | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| insert (`engine.ts`, the per-row admit loop) | none | unchanged: every supplied value is judged |
| update by id (`engine.ts`, after the validation rules) | `priorRecord`, always read there (the not-found gate) | a refused value the row already stores is forgiven |
| predicate update, `multi: true` (`engine.ts`, the bulk call site) | the `readPriorRows` memo (the matched rows), read only after a refusal | forgiven only when every matched row stores it; zero matched rows forgive nothing |
| dry run (`engine-validate.ts`) | n/a | runs the check in `insert` mode only, so unchanged |
| upsert | n/a | the engine has no upsert door (`update.options.upsert` is retired), so there is no fourth site |

The delete walk is untouched: `DELETE_SEMANTICS_REFERENCE_TYPES` still leaves `user` out by declaration (moving it is a spec change).

Route B covers the single `user` field as well as the multi-valued one. The previous measurement on this card (os-dev-report 6571331581) showed the single field refused the same way: a PATCH carrying `f_user` unchanged after the user was removed answered 400 `reference_not_found`. The rule is not special-cased by type, so it applies to `lookup` and `master_detail` the same way: a stored value carried back unchanged answers what omitting it answers.

## Tests

New `describe('[#29062] …')` in `packages/objectql/src/engine-lookup-referential-integrity.test.ts`, reusing that file's stub driver. The fixture deletes a `sys_user` row through `engine.delete` after a holder row names it, so the stored ghost is the one the delete walk really leaves:

- a single `user` field carried back unchanged passes;
- a multi `user` field carried back unchanged passes;
- a multi `user` field keeping its stored ghost and adding a new ghost refuses only the new one (`fields` length 1, `value: u_never`), and the stored value does not move;
- a single `user` field repointed at another missing user is still refused;
- an insert naming the deleted user is still refused;
- a `lookup` (single and multi) that adds a missing id is still refused, member by member;
- a bulk update forgives a value only when every matched row already holds it (over h1 alone it passes; over h1 and h2, where it is new to h2, it is refused and h2 is not written).

**Forced test edit:** `packages/objectql/src/engine-unreadable-master-detail-header.test.ts`, the `%s — a refused read of the header object answers as a nonexistent header id` case. For the `repoint by id` and `bulk repoint` doors it wrote `h_mine_open`, which is the header line `l1` already stores (its `beforeEach`), so the write was not a repoint at all and is now forgiven like an omitted key. The case now names `h_mine_locked`, another existing header Carol cannot read, so all four doors still pin "an existing unreadable header answers what a nonexistent one does". Nothing else in that file moved; 30/30 pass.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, reported on the card and not fixed here: the stock dev admin gets 403 on admin remove-user; `deleteBehavior` on a `user` field is declared but not enforced.
- A `master_detail` header the caller cannot read, carried back unchanged, now passes (it is the value the row stores, and omitting the key already passed). A repoint to an unreadable header is still refused as a nonexistent one.

## Verification

<details><summary>Red first on base 2af0ae2a</summary>

`vitest run src/engine-lookup-referential-integrity.test.ts` with only the new tests committed: `Tests 4 failed | 17 passed (21)`. Failing: single unchanged, multi unchanged, stored ghost plus new ghost (`expected [...] to have a length of 1 but got 2`), bulk. Cause line: `ValidationError: Owner: no sys_user record has id "u_gone"`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. The old "judge every carried value" behaviour put back (`const stored = [];` in place of the stored-row read): `Tests 4 failed | 17 passed (21)`, the same four cases.
2. `every` matched row changed to `some` matched row: `Tests 1 failed | 20 passed (21)`, only the bulk case.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests and gates on the final head 49f236e7 (origin/main merged twice; the second merge brings #29060)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: `Test Files 527 passed (527)`, `Tests 10145 passed (10145)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- #29060's suites against this change: `service-automation` `runas-system-reference-check.integration.test.ts` + `builtin/crud-runas.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 44 passed (44)`. The flow-write reference check #29060 added and this change compose: a flow repointing a field at a deleted user is still refused; a stored value carried back is forgiven on either caller.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths): 63 families derived; all 63 run with exit codes recorded; `--ran`: 62 run, 1 NOT MEASURED. The one is `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach); declared to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
